fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: A running strike at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full range. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each, and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Trail Gone Red
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to a target and strike it for 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Out of Reach
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Scent of the Flagging
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
